text: {"observations":"I could not listen to the audio, so this is an estimate from the clip length alone. At a typical speaking rate of roughly 2.5 words per second, an 18.8 s utterance holds about 45-50 words, and in standard pronunciation dictionaries nearly every word carries a stressed phoneme. That makes forty-two (A) plausible and makes ten, thirteen and sixteen (D, B, C) too low for a clip of this length unless the speech is very slow or sparse.","answer":"A"}
